issue: New entry not persisted after page reload
actual: Created entry "Zeta QA Audit" (Priority 5, Mar 10 2026, Completed checked, Score 42) appeared immediately and count went 5→6 entries. After reloading http://localhost:6074/, the table shows only the 5 original seed entries ("5 entries") and the new entry is gone (the added "Score" field also disappeared).
evidence: Post-reload tbody rows: Design new landing page, Review marketing materials, Update API documentation, Prepare quarterly report, Team sync meeting notes
Fields dialog offers Text/Number/Date/Checkbox; added field "Score" (Number). It appeared as a new table column, a card row label, and a number input in the Add Entry form.

Field-type dropdown options labeled "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox". Add Entry form renders input[type=text] for Task Name, input[type=number] for Priority/Score, input[type=date] for Due Date, and a checkbox with Yes/No label for Completed.
Priority/Score render as input[type=number]; pressSequentially("abc") left value "0" (no non-numeric text accepted, validity.badInput=false). Valid values 5 and 42 saved and displayed as 5 and 42.

Due Date is input[type=date]; attempting to fill "2026-02-31" was rejected ("Malformed value"), and setting that value via DOM left the field empty. Valid date 2026-03-10 saved and displayed as "Mar 10, 2026".
Saved entry "Zeta QA Audit" with text, number 5, date 2026-03-10, checkbox checked, number 42. Table shows: Zeta QA Audit | 5 | Mar 10, 2026 | check icon | 42; cards show same with "Yes".
Switching Cards→Table and back kept 6 entries with identical field values in both views.
All 6 entries and every field value match between views; empty Score renders as "—" in both table cells and card rows.
Form checkbox toggles between unchecked "No" and checked "Yes" (aria-checked). Table uses lucide-check (text-success) vs lucide-x (muted); cards show "Yes"/"No" with matching icons.

Table: Priority asc (1,1,2,2,3,5) then desc (5,3,2,2,1,1) via header click. Cards: Sort menu lists all 5 fields; Task Name asc then desc. Switching Cards→Table kept Priority↓ (button "Priority" + arrow-down); Table→Cards kept Task Name↓ — independent per view.

Before/after sorting the count stayed "6 entries" and each row's Task Name/Priority/Due Date/Completed/Score values were unchanged (e.g. Zeta QA Audit | 5 | Mar 10, 2026 | check | 42 in every ordering).

Selecting a sort field reorders instantly; active field shown on the Sort button label and header, direction shown by arrow-up/arrow-down icon; other controls (view toggle, Add Entry, search) remained functional afterwards.

actual: The app exposes only Fields, a free-text "Search entries..." box, a Sort menu, Table/Cards toggle and Add Entry. No filter control is present in either view: document.body.innerHTML contains no occurrence of "filter", column headers only trigger sorting, and right-clicking a header opens no menu. Therefore field-specific filter criteria cannot be defined or cleared.

issue: Filtering not implemented, so inclusion/clearing behavior cannot hold
actual: No filter UI exists anywhere in the app (no "filter" string in the DOM, no filter control in table or card view), so there are no active criteria to satisfy and no filters to clear.

The only occurrence of "import" in the app is the advisory note in the Configure Fields dialog ("Configure fields before importing data."). There is no import button, no input[type=file] (0 found), and no paste/CSV UI in either view, so data cannot be imported after defining a schema and type-mismatch rejection cannot be exercised.

issue: Quick search matches raw stored values, not displayed formatted values
actual: Entry displays date "Mar 10, 2026" and checkbox "Yes", but searching "Mar 10" returns "0 entries matching" and "Yes" returns "0 entries matching". Searching the internal raw values instead works: "2026-03-10" → 1 entry (Zeta QA Audit) and "true" → 3 entries (the three checked ones).

evidence: Query "MARKETING" (uppercase) matched "Review marketing materials" and footer showed "1 entry matching \"MARKETING\""; clearing the box restored all 6 rows with footer "6 entries".

After "Clear sort" (footer: "Drag entries to reorder"), keyboard drag on the row handle moved "Design new landing page" from position 1 to 3 in the table; in cards, drag moved it from 1 to 2. Switching views preserved each view's distinct manual order (table: Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Zeta; cards: Review, Design, Update, Prepare, Team, Zeta).
